nodes.title: MLX Text Generation
nodes.description:
Generate text using locally cached MLX models on Apple Silicon.
    text, generation, mlx, local-llm

    Use cases:
    - Fast local iteration with MLX-converted instruction models
    - Privacy-preserving summarization, drafting, or Q&A
    - Building multi-node agent workflows without external APIs

properties.name: model
properties.title: Model
properties.description: MLX language model to use for generation. The model must be available in the local Hugging Face cache.

properties.name: system_prompt
properties.title: System Prompt
properties.description: Optional system prompt used to steer the model.

properties.name: prompt
properties.title: Prompt
properties.description: The user prompt used for generation.

properties.name: max_new_tokens
properties.title: Max New Tokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens the model should generate.

properties.name: temperature
properties.title: Temperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature. Set to 0 for deterministic output.

properties.name: top_p
properties.title: Top P
properties.description: Nucleus sampling probability mass.

properties.name: top_k
properties.title: Top K
properties.description: Limits sampling to the top K tokens at each step.

properties.name: min_p
properties.title: Min P
properties.description: Minimum token probability threshold (0 disables).

properties.name: min_tokens_to_keep
properties.title: Min Tokens To Keep
properties.description: Ensures at least this many tokens remain after filtering.

nodes.title: MLX Whisper
nodes.description:
Transcribe an audio asset using MLX Whisper.
    whisper, mlx, asr, speech-to-text

    - Uses MLX for efficient Apple Silicon acceleration
    - Returns transcript and segments with optional word-level timestamps

properties.name: model
properties.title: Model
properties.description: Model to use for transcription

properties.name: audio
properties.title: Audio Input
properties.description: The input audio to transcribe.

properties.name: compression_ratio_threshold
properties.title: Compression Ratio Threshold
properties.description: Threshold for gzip compression ratio; above this, the result is treated as failed.

properties.name: logprob_threshold
properties.title: Logprob Threshold
properties.description: Average log probability threshold; below this, the result is treated as failed.

properties.name: no_speech_threshold
properties.title: No Speech Threshold
properties.description: Threshold for no-speech probability; if exceeded and logprob is low, the segment is considered silent.

properties.name: condition_on_previous_text
properties.title: Condition On Previous Text
properties.description: If True, the previous output is used as a prompt for the next window, improving consistency.

properties.name: word_timestamps
properties.title: Word Timestamps
properties.description: If True, extracts word-level timestamps using cross-attention and dynamic time warping.
